name: Lantern Meadow
author: kolache
description: A calm painted meadow you read beside, not on top of. Warm paper by day, ink-blue by night, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Lexend, one amber lantern ring on the newest reply, the message box and dialogs. Long replies sit in a 70-character reading column with the speaker's name kept in view. No motion. All text measured at 4.5:1 or better on the real pixels behind it.
